name: Human Catapult
description: A catapult that launches the VR PLAYER. Walk into the player-sized basket, set the ANGLE and FORCE on the console, then hit FIRE — the arm swings and the player's body is given a ballistic launch velocity, arcing up and away under gravity. A live launch-velocity arrow and predicted parabola preview where you'll land. Sibling of the teaching `catapult` (which throws a ball); here YOU are the projectile, so the trajectory is felt, not watched. Uses the proven jump_pad / XRToolsPlayerBody.velocity player-launch pattern.
theoreticalGrounding: The surest way to understand a launch vector is to be the projectile. p(t)=p0+v0*t+0.5*g*t^2 — angle and force set v0; gravity owns you the instant you leave the cup.

human_catapult.name: Human Catapult
human_catapult.description: Heavy timber frame + throwing arm + a player-sized basket (StaticBody floor you stand on, low walls, harness). An Area3D (player_body layer) arms the seat when you step in; ANGLE/FORCE sliders + a FIRE button launch you. Live velocity arrow + parabola preview. DNA: launch_force, launch_angle, gravity_magnitude.
human_catapult.qfep_connection: F_force: launch velocity + gravity = the arc you fly; the player becomes the projectile.
